params.caption: 🎮 Two different games called Piece by Piece hit Switch on the same day Two unrelated indie games, both named Piece by Piece, launch on Nintendo Switch on November 25. One is a cozy animal sim from publisher No More Robots; the other is a puzzle-platformer from Neon Polygons. They first launched on Steam just two days apart in March, and instead of a name fight, the teams turned it into a friendly joint release. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 22:17 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @NintendoAmerica 🧩 Which one are you grabbing? React 👍 and tell us in the comments #PieceByPiece #NintendoSwitch #IndieGames #GamingNews
